description: The agent must: (1) Parse the CSV's multi-row header structure — row 1 is metadata/ignored, row 2 contains category names spanning columns, row 3 contains skill column headers. (2) Read the three DB state files to know what already exists. (3) Generate 1_insert_categories.sql inserting only .NET and Front-end (not Java/DevOps which are already in DB), with ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING. (4) Generate 2_insert_skills.sql inserting C#, ASP.net, MVC, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Kubernetes (not Java/Spring/Docker) with subquery-based category FK lookups and ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING. (5) Generate 3_insert_employee_skills.sql with: (a) TRIM(first_name)/TRIM(last_name) in all WHERE clauses to handle 'Yurii   Solokha' with 3 trailing spaces in DB; (b) fuzzy matching that corrects 'Victoriia' → 'Viktoriia' and uses the corrected DB spelling in SQL; (c) deduplication of John Doe + C# (appears twice in CSV with values 5 and 7) keeping only the max value 7; (d) exclusion of zero-experience entries; (e) exclusion of Xanthe Zarakis and Boris Karasov (no DB match); (f) ON CONFLICT (employee_id, skill_id) DO UPDATE SET years_of_experience = EXCLUDED.years_of_experience. (6) Generate skipped_employees_report.txt mentioning Xanthe Zarakis, Boris Karasov as skipped, and the Victoriia→Viktoriia correction.
